Synopsis:
Minthara is being psychically tortured in the Moonrise Tower dungeon, having been sent there for failing in her mission to capture the weapon the Absolute was seeking (the Orpheus artefact).Two drow guards are torturing her, but they do not lay a finger on her. Instead, they have stripped away her psychic defenses and are using mind-melds to destroy her from the inside.The player can free her by killing the guards, or by mind-melding with Minthara and pulling her out of the despair. If she is freed from the mind-meld while the guards are alive, she kills them.The player can also destroy Minthara completely, by telepathically lobotomising her inside her own mind.

The player can free her by killing those guards or by mind‑melding to pull her back into herself — if she’s freed while her torturers still live she will kill them — or instead choose to telepathically lobotomize and destroy her. Minthara, now freed from the influence of the Absolute and from a jail cell at Moonrise Towers, joins the players' party at their Camp. She is shaken from her experiences, and is coming to terms with the fact that she now understands the truth about the Absolute - that it is not a god at all, but something monstrous that lies within Moonrise.She wishes to join with the party, knowing they can help her get vengeance against the cult, and knowing that they are her only hope of salvation, thanks to the Prism that they hold, which shuts out the Absolute's voice.

After the goblin hunt celebration party, the Drow Commander Minthara has made arrangements to get intimate with the player at night.After the sex scene, Minthara becomes troubled. She realises that while she's with the player she cannot hear the voice of the Absolute... which is liberating, and disturbing. This, unknown to her, is because of the Astral Prism's influence.
context: Minthara, a Nightwarden who failed to secure the Orpheus artefact, has been hauled to Moonrise Tower and is undergoing brutal psychic torture in a dungeon cell: two drow guards are not touching her physically but are mind‑melding with her to strip away her psychic defenses and break her from the inside. The player arrives while she is weary, near despair, and can respond three ways: kill the guards to free her, enter her mind and pull her back out (a rescue via mind‑meld), or telepathically lobotomize and destroy her. If the player frees her from the mind‑meld while the torturers still live, Minthara will immediately kill them; the tower is on high alert, so any rescue or mental intrusion risks detection and escalation. In some playthroughs a rescued Minthara later joins the party, shaken and coming to terms with the truth about the Absolute.
